doc: Common tool every platform SERVICE bundle implements as <platform>.live.channels (twitch, youtube, discord, kick). The host resolves the community's connected channels itself; the caller never supplies channel ids. Output carries channel/stream metadata only -- no user PII. Optional fields are absent or null when the platform does not know them. Failures are LOUD: the tool errors with an invalid-args message whose text starts with one of error_codes (optionally followed by ': detail'); there is no empty-success fallback. Discord maps 'live' to a member Go-Live/streaming presence or an active stage channel in a linked guild (channel_ref identifies the voice/stage channel or guild-scoped streamer ref, display_name the channel/stage name, title the stage topic or streamed activity name, viewers the voice/stage audience count).
